strings.zh: 很久以前,漩涡岛是一个大岛。{SCROLL}但是岛上的分裂份子为了{NEWLINE}要把这个岛分成两半{CLEAR}而战争不断。{SCROLL}岛的守护神洛奇亚为此很生气,{SCROLL}就用雷电把岛分成了4份,{SCROLL}然后在漩涡岛上的瀑布深处{CLEAR}躲了起来……{SCROLL}把据说是洛奇亚身上掉下来的{CLEAR}银色的羽毛拿来的话,{CLEAR}这里就让你过去吧。{SCROLL}但是问题是洛奇亚会不会{CLEAR}在那里出现,{SCROLL}洛奇亚真正期待的是{CLEAR}人类与精灵{CLEAR}之间的,肉眼看不见的信赖……{SCROLL}不,应该是{NEWLINE}能让它重新找回信赖{CLEAR}的人物吧……
strings.en: Long ago, the Whirl Islands{NEWLINE}were one large island.{SCROLL}But separatists on the island waged{NEWLINE}endless war to split it in two.{SCROLL}Lugia, the guardian of the{NEWLINE}island, grew angry and split it{CLEAR}into four pieces with lightning,{SCROLL}then hid itself deep behind the{NEWLINE}waterfall of the Whirl Islands...{SCROLL}If you bring the Silver Wing,{NEWLINE}which is said to have fallen{CLEAR}from Lugia, I will let you pass.{SCROLL}But the real question is{NEWLINE}whether Lugia will appear there.{SCROLL}What Lugia truly longs for is the unseen{NEWLINE}trust between people and Pokémon...{SCROLL}No, rather a person who can{NEWLINE}help it find that trust again...
strings.notes: US line retranslated: the hack's zh has 分裂份子 (separatists) fighting to split the island, not two countries.

strings.zh: 在这个岛上的精灵,{NEWLINE}也就是洛奇亚,{CLEAR}藏在瀑布深处{CLEAR}再没出现过。{SCROLL}如果有一名与{NEWLINE}精灵有着深刻羁绊的人{CLEAR}拿着某个与{CLEAR}洛奇亚相关的物品去那……{SCROLL}说不定洛奇亚{NEWLINE}会出现……
strings.en: Lugia, the Pokémon of this island, hid{NEWLINE}deep behind the waterfall and has never{CLEAR}appeared since. If someone with a deep{CLEAR}bond with Pokémon went there carrying{CLEAR}something connected to Lugia... Lugia{CLEAR}might just appear...
strings.notes: US 0124/1; modernised from US 0124#1 | RV045: meaning: US line changed the condition to restoring trust; zh is a person with deep bonds with Pokémon going there (D-1662)

strings.zh: 火箭队的人突然跑来这里,{NEWLINE}硬是闯进了洛奇亚沉睡的禁地。{CLEAR}施主你能来到这里{CLEAR}应该是很厉害的训练家吧,{CLEAR}拜托你阻止火箭队好吗？
strings.en: Team Rocket suddenly showed up{NEWLINE}here and forced their way into the{CLEAR}forbidden ground where Lugia sleeps.{SCROLL}Traveler, if you made it here, you{NEWLINE}must be a very skilled Trainer.{CLEAR}Will you please stop Team Rocket?
strings.notes: Speaker is a Sage/monk guarding the Lugia chamber (施主 → traveler).

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你们果然出现在这了,火箭队。{NEWLINE}这次你们是想捕捉{CLEAR}沉睡在海底的洛奇亚吧？{CLEAR}我不会让你们得逞的,{CLEAR}赶紧把路让开！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I knew you’d show up{NEWLINE}here, Team Rocket. This time{CLEAR}you’re after Lugia, sleeping at{CLEAR}the bottom of the sea, right?{SCROLL}I won’t let you get away{NEWLINE}with it. Get out of my way!

strings.zh: 你是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！？{NEWLINE}没想到这么快就来了……{CLEAR}但是我奉命在这里把守,{CLEAR}你休想从我这过去！
strings.en: You’re League Champion {VAR:0103:0}?! I{NEWLINE}didn’t think you’d get here so fast...{SCROLL}But I’ve got orders to guard this spot.{NEWLINE}Don’t even think about getting past me!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『既然你不肯让路,{NEWLINE}那就别怪我不客气了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: If you won’t step aside, then{NEWLINE}don’t blame me for what happens next!

strings.zh: 我已经尽力了……{NEWLINE}得赶紧向吉尔露太大人报告才行。
strings.en: I did my best... I have to report{NEWLINE}to Master Lawrence right away.

strings.zh: 施主,一定不能让洛奇亚{NEWLINE}落入火箭队之手啊！{CLEAR}拜托你了！
strings.en: Traveler, you must not let Lugia fall{NEWLINE}into Team Rocket’s hands! I beg you!

strings.zh: 没想到洛奇亚居然会落入火箭队之手,{NEWLINE}这可如何是好啊……
strings.en: I never imagined Lugia would{NEWLINE}fall into Team Rocket’s{CLEAR}hands. What are we to do...?

strings.zh: 施主是联盟冠军大人吧？{NEWLINE}听说是您从火箭队手中解放了洛奇亚。{CLEAR}那么您应该就是最有资格{CLEAR}成为洛奇亚训练家的人了。
strings.en: Traveler, you are the League{NEWLINE}Champion, are you not? I hear it was{CLEAR}you who freed Lugia from Team Rocket.{SCROLL}Then you must be the one most{NEWLINE}worthy of becoming Lugia’s Trainer.

strings.zh: 恭喜施主得到洛奇亚的认可！{NEWLINE}可喜可贺啊！
strings.en: Congratulations on winning{NEWLINE}Lugia’s approval, traveler!{CLEAR}A joyous day indeed!
